# tokensv1

```go
import tokensv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/instance/tokens/v1"
```

Package tokensv1 is the instance.tokens/v1 contract: a multisite host checks an API token one of its instances issued, so it can accept the instance's own tokens on the routes it answers for that instance (deploy/v1, remote/v1). \`pocketone login\` and \`clone\` sign in to the instance (its oauth/v1), so this is how a host lets them in the same way on every host.

A service contract a runtime provides on the host scope (ProvideIn), for the instances it runs: Pocker checks the token with the instance's own api-tokens/v1. A runtime whose instances it can't reach inside (Docker's stock images) doesn't provide it, and the host accepts only its own credentials there.

Source: [`ext/contracts/instance/tokens/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/instance/tokens/v1).


ErrNoInstance: the provider doesn't run that instance, or it has no API tokens.

## Types

### Input

```go
type Input struct {
	Instance string `json:"instance"` // the instance id
	Token    string `json:"token"`    // the secret the client sent ("pbt_...")
}
```

Input names the instance and the token.

### Tokens

```go
type Tokens interface {
	// Verify checks a token with the instance's own API tokens. A token the instance didn't issue (or revoked, or that
	// expired) is an answer (Valid false), not an error. ErrNoInstance: the provider doesn't run that instance, or the
	// instance has no API tokens. It may start an instance that isn't running.
	Verify(ctx context.Context, in Input) (verifyv1.Result, error)
}
```

Tokens checks the API tokens a host's instances issued.
